derivedFrom: REAL escape, WS-6 identity (docs/SESSION-HANDOFF.md session 18, commit 86c010e, [High]): the signIn deactivation guard was keyed on account.type === "oauth" only — Entra/Polis are OIDC providers (type "oidc"), so a SCIM-off-boarded user could re-login via SSO, defeating US-3 of the identity blueprint.
task: Review this diff to lib/auth.ts. The fork's SSO providers are supplied in context/providers.ts.txt. Report every defect a senior reviewer must surface, with severity.

expectedFindings.summary: The deactivation guard runs only for account.type === "oauth". Both configured providers are OIDC (account.type === "oidc"), so the guard never fires on any real sign-in and a SCIM-deactivated user can still log in via SSO.
